verdict.rationale: Skyvern supports multi-step workflows via code-first Browser Automation SDK and a visual Cloud UI with drag-and-drop blocks, plus parameterized data extraction schemas, but the evidence pack does not explicitly document loop/iteration constructs or conditional branching primitives within workflows, and independent commentary highlights reliability gaps on complex multi-step flows (e.g., failing to click popups on costcotravel.com) and lack of assertion/validation controls compared to Playwright. missing for 10: explicit documentation of loop and conditional-branching constructs in the workflow builder, and independent verification that complex multi-step workflows run reliably end-to-end.
